plans.name: H2 pool fast health retry rotation
Auto H2 pool fast health rotation H3 fallback

selection_rule: Eligible: >=98% soak probes, all normal file integrity samples pass, both recovery cases succeed. Score: 40% soak availability, 25% recovery quality (30s stale TCP / 8s TCP outage), 25% relative serial throughput, 10% relative probe p95. Equal score favors fewer fallback attempts.
limitations: One Windows client and one server; short serial experiments do not prove or exclude ISP QoS.
Performance connects directly to real WAN; recovery uses a local TCP/UDP relay to impose faults, not ISP shaping.
Faults affect only this lab; no global firewall, sysctl or system proxy changes.
Existing application streams are not migrated or replayed. Only new requests can recover or change carrier.
ISO testing is limited to 32MiB per strategy; no full-ISO or playback validation.
